preparation: A trapped giant vesicle imaged by confocal z-stacks before and after deflation. Movie S1 identifies the Figure 2b specimen and its bath. External calcein reveals bath-origin liquid in the inward tube.

reconstruction_errors.scope: Approximate errors from confocal z-resolution. The reported ± values carry no stated sampling distribution. No separate uncertainty is supplied for tube dimensions.

mapping: Initial area and volume are approximate, and the initial vesicle has no inward tube. Total membrane area includes the tube and lumen volume excludes its liquid. Treating the tube as a straight cylinder is a shape scenario. The ideal comparison assumes initial osmotic balance at the prepared concentration, fixed membrane area and retained osmoles. Figure 4 follows a separate 92 to 117 mM exchange. Its interior concentration is inferred from volume using solute conservation.
